entities.summary: Jacek Jan Kuroń was a Polish social activist, politician, and one of the most prominent democratic leaders of the opposition in the People's Republic of Poland (PRL). Kuroń played a pivotal role in challenging Communist rule and advocating for democratic reforms during the latter half of the 20th century. After the PRL fell in 1989, Kuroń served as Minister of Labour and Social Policy twice in post-communist Poland, from 1989 to 1990 in the government of Tadeusz Mazowiecki and from 1992 to 1993 in the government of Hanna Suchocka.

entities.summary: Jacek Jan Kuroń was a Polish social activist, politician, and one of the most prominent democratic leaders of the opposition in the People's Republic of Poland (PRL). Kuroń played a pivotal role in challenging Communist rule and advocating for democratic reforms during the latter half of the 20th century. After the PRL fell in 1989, Kuroń served as Minister of Labour and Social Policy twice in post-communist Poland, from 1989 to 1990 in the government of Tadeusz Mazowiecki and from 1992 to 1993 in the government of Hanna Suchocka.
